response.overview: My short film is based on the coming of age genre, followed by  the (slight) psychological thriller/drama genre. Centring my main character, Phoebe. Phoebe is being ‘haunted’ by her past memories, where her perception of herself and others were truly different, leading her to believe she isn’t who she wanted to ever become. Throughout the constant memories haunting Phoebe, she falls into a deep and constant depressive episode, isolating herself from everyone that comes her way.  As Phoebe struggles, constantly scrolling on her phone, she comes across an unknown caller, claiming they can make her forget and she can be happy again, just by doing as they say. Phoebe falls out of her episode and finds someone new to become friends with, until she receives a phone call from that unknown caller again. Is her new friendship already over?
response.title: Haze
